svg.text: S5 PATERNOSTER CHECK — why a vertical carousel holds only 51 boxes in 600 mm depth
Rigid carriers collide in the turns unless they are far apart; the ring rack removes the turns instead.
loop in 553 mm depth: turn radius ≤ 188 mm
chain pitch ≥ 226 mm: 47 % of the chain is air
cradles touch; 28 per lane, 84 in 3 lanes

g.text: 1/3 A paternoster loop fits 553 mm of depth only with a 188 mm turn radius. Carriers 120 mm apart (A) hit each other in every turn.
2/3 To pass the turns the pivots must be at least 213 mm apart, a chain pitch of 226 mm (B): 17 carriers × 3 boxes = 51 boxes.
3/3 The ring rack (C) keeps the cradles touching and replaces each turn by a straight push: 28 cradles per lane, 168 places.
